meta.title: Maritime Safety Evidence Observatory
meta.source: UK Marine Accident Investigation Branch (MAIB) public data portal
meta.method_note: Counts describe reported occurrences and are not exposure-adjusted accident rates.

notes.model: Multivariable logistic regression of serious/very serious classification among reported occurrences. Odds ratios are adjusted for all displayed factors.
notes.person: Person-level flows describe affected-person records and do not measure population risk.
notes.vessel: Damage shares are conditional on vessels appearing in the published occurrence records.
